mutation.rationale: Mutation score is not inferred from line or branch coverage; a pinned mutation tool, scope and minimum score must be selected before claiming qualification.
mutation.next: Run a bounded scheduled mutation lane over validators and publication state, retain the raw report and set an approved threshold.

dst.rationale: Persisted timestamps are normalized to UTC and the current public contract has no local-time scheduling or civil-time arithmetic.
dst.boundary: If local-time scheduling, calendar windows or timezone-aware source updates are added, add zoneinfo transition fixtures before enabling them.

contract.boundary: Python schema and integrity contracts are exercised; Rust or separately implemented consumer parity remains a release-track gate.

ci.boundary: The repository does not claim secret-scanning qualification until a hosted scanner and retained result are configured.

release_boundary: This record documents applicability and evidence boundaries; it does not close the v1 quality frontier, mutation qualification, cross-language parity or hosted secret-scanning gates.
